verdict.rationale: Lorikeet explicitly documents auditing knowledge bases at scale to find gaps and quality issues, plus replaying historical/synthetic tickets to surface knowledge gaps before deploying agents on trained topics, directly addressing the story's core ask. Diagnose-ticket tracing further helps identify where the agent fumbled due to content issues. Missing for 10: no evidence of explicit 'conflicting content' detection (vs. gaps/outdated content) and no independent/customer corroboration of these audit features working in practice.
